post-1.title: Warm chamomile tea + hot water bottle saved my Day 1 cramps today
post-1.content: Just wanted to share a gentle reminder to anyone having a tough Day 1. Chamomile tea with a pinch of ginger and resting flat on my back with a hot water bag reduced my pain level from an 8 to a 3. Please take it easy today!

post-2.title: First time using a menstrual cup — here is what helped me seal it correctly!
post-2.content: I was so nervous for months! What finally worked for me was the punch-down fold instead of C-fold, and relaxing my shoulders completely. If you are struggling on your first try, don’t panic! Take a deep breath and try in the shower.

post-3.title: Day 24 luteal phase anxiety — does anyone else feel super sensitive right now?
post-3.content: Every small thing feels a bit heavier today. I know it’s just progesterone dropping, but knowing doesn’t always stop the feeling. Holding space for anyone else feeling emotional in their pre-period phase.

comments.c-1: Chamomile tea is so soothing! Adding a tiny drop of honey makes it even better.
comments.c-2: Sending virtual warmth! Rest up today 💕
comments.c-3: Punch-down fold is definitely the game-changer! So proud of you for trying!
comments.c-4: You are so not alone. Luteal phase sensitivity is so real. Be extra gentle with yourself today 💕
